# Pynor — Free Enterprise Uptime & Performance Monitoring

> A free uptime infrastructure platform engineered by Oladizz Agency (https://oladizz.xyz).

## Overview
Pynor is an uptime monitoring and status page platform providing real-time HTTP/HTTPS health checks, incident lifecycle tracking, automated downtime notifications (Telegram, Webhooks), and shareable public status pages.

## Key Features
- Automated 1-minute to 24-hour background ping scheduling
- Incident State Machine: ongoing outage tracking with calculated downtime duration
- Instant Telegram bot alerts and Webhook dispatching on downtime and recovery
- Public Status Pages (`?status=<url>`) accessible without login
- Built-in AI root-cause diagnostics powered by Gemini
- Free Tier: Core monitoring is provided 100% free of charge

## Company & Ecosystem
Pynor is the free flagship acquisition hook of Oladizz Agency.
